blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Images reveal appearances, but counting often asks about physical objects. A single entity may be visible directly, in several reflections, or through glass, so detecting every visible occurrence does not determine how many entities are present. Existing visual counting benchmarks rarely separate these two operations. We introduce PhysCount, a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can distinguish what appears in an image from what physically exists in the scene. PhysCount contains 546 real-world images and 4,595 human-written questions organized into 651 target-specific groups. For each group, annotators locate the relevant appearances, label how each is observed, and identify appearances of the same entity. Four complementary question families test the enumeration of appearances, the enumeration of physical entities, image-formation-specific counting, and appearance--entity correspondence. We measure both accuracy on each family and the proportion of groups answered entirely correctly. Across 40 MLLMs, counting visible appearances is substantially easier than recovering the identities that connect them. Even the strongest model answers every question correctly in only 13.36\% of groups. Performance declines when one entity produces many appearances or when its appearances cross observation modes. Higher image resolution improves access to visual evidence but brings limited gains in complete-group accuracy, whereas answering related questions jointly produces a marked improvement. These results expose a gap between recognizing what is visible and correctly recovering the physical entities behind those observations.
blocks.zh: 图像显示出外观,但计数时常会询问物理物体. 一个单一的实体可能直接可见,在几个反射中,或者通过玻璃可以被看见,所以检测出每个可见的发生并不决定有多少实体存在. 现有的可视计数基准很少将这两个业务分开. 我们引入了PhysCount,这是评价多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)是否能够区分图像中出现的东西和现场实际存在的东西的基准. PhysCount包含546个真实世界的图像和4,595个人写问题,被组织成651个目标群体. 对于每一组,注释者确定相关外观的位置,对每个外观进行标记,并标明同一实体的外观。 四个补充问题家庭测试外观的取出,物理实体的取出,图像成形特定取出,外观实体取出. 我们既衡量每个家庭的准确性,又衡量完全正确回答的群体比例。 在40个MLLM中,计算可见外观比恢复连接它们的身份要容易得多。 即使是最强的模型 也只正确回答了13.36分组的每个问题 当一个实体产生出许多外观时或其外观交叉观察模式时,性能会下降. 更高的图像分辨率可以改善视觉证据的获取,但在完整组的准确性方面带来有限的收益,而共同回答相关问题则会产生明显的改善. 这些结果暴露出在识别可见的事物和正确恢复这些观测背后的物理实体之间存在着差距。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Intelligent perception requires recovering a stable physical world from changing and sometimes misleading appearances. Developmental psychology studies this ability through the appearance–reality distinction: children gradually learn that changes in how an object looks do not imply changes in what the object is Flavell et al. (1983) . Theories of object perception describe a similar process in which observations are organized around persistent physical units Spelke (1990) , with “object files” connecting different appearances that are understood as states of the same object Kahneman et al. (1992) . The importance of this ability becomes especially clear when visible evidence conflicts with physical structure. Mirror self-recognition experiments test whether an animal relates a reflected body to itself Gallup (1970) , while a transparent barrier leaves a target fully visible but physically inaccessible Kabadayi et al. (2017) . In both cases, successful behavior depends on interpreting the observation through the entities and relations that produce it. Sensory appearances provide evidence about the world, but they are not themselves the physical units into which the world is organized.
blocks.zh: 智能感知需要从不断变化的外观中恢复一个稳定的物理世界,有时也会误导外观. 发育心理学通过外观-真实性区别来研究这种能力:儿童逐渐地认识到,物体外观的变化并不意味着物体是Flavel等人(1983年)的变化。 物体感知理论描述了一种类似的过程,即观测围绕持久性物理单位Spelke(1990年)组织,“物体文件”连接不同的外观,这些外观被理解为同一物体的状态Kahneman等人(1992年)。 当明显的证据与物理结构相冲突时,这种能力的重要性就变得特别明显了。 镜像自我识别实验测试动物是否将反射出的身体与自己Gallup(1970年)联系起来,而透明的屏障则使目标完全可见,但实际无法进入Kabadayi等人(2017年). 在这两种情况下,成功的行为都取决于通过产生观察的实体和关系来解释观察. 感官外观为世界提供了证据,但它们本身并不是世界组织到的物理单位.

blocks.en: This distinction is equally consequential for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). A mirror can make one object appear multiple times in an image without creating additional entities, and an object seen through glass remains a physical entity despite the intervening surface. A model may therefore identify every visible instance and still answer incorrectly if it treats each appearance as a separate thing. Counting in such scenes requires more than locating targets and adding them up; the model must determine which observations arise from the same entity. This leads to the central question of this work: Do MLLMs count visual appearances or physical entities?
blocks.zh: 这种区分对多式大型语言模型(MLLMs)来说也是同样的结果. 一个镜像可以使一个物体在图像中多次出现而不产生额外的实体,一个通过玻璃所看到的物体尽管受到干扰的表面仍然是一个物理实体. 因此,一个模型如果将每个外观作为单独的东西处理,可能会识别出每一个可见实例,并且仍然不正确回答. 在这样的场景中进行计数需要的不仅仅是确定目标的位置并将其相加;模型必须确定来自同一实体的观测结果。 这就产生了这项工作的核心问题: MLLMs是否计算视觉外观或物理实体?

blocks.en: Figure 1: One scene, different counting units. Five cat appearances correspond to four entities because D1 and R1 depict the same cat. With the image and target fixed, the questions count all appearances (5), distinct entities (4), reflections (2), or entities seen both directly and in reflection (1).
blocks.zh: 图1:一个场景,不同的计数单位. 5只猫的外观对应了4个实体,因为D1和R1描绘了同一只猫. 在图像和目标固定后,问题算上所有外观(5),不同的实体(4),反射(2),或者直接和反射中看到的实体(1).

blocks.en: Existing visual counting tasks typically begin with a target category and treat visible instances as the units to be counted, whether through question answering, category-agnostic counting, language-guided density estimation, or multimodal numerosity evaluation Acharya et al. (2019) ; Ranjan et al. (2021) ; Jiang et al. (2023) ; Paiss et al. (2023) . These formulations evaluate whether a model can locate and enumerate the requested targets, while leaving the counting unit implicit. Mirrors, transparent surfaces, and repeated imaging paths separate visible appearances from physical entities. One entity may produce several spatially distinct observations, so the same visual inventory can support different counts depending on how those observations are grouped. Answering “how many” therefore requires both recovering the appearances and determining which of them share a physical source.
blocks.zh: 现有的可视化计数任务一般从一个目标类别入手,将可见的例作为应计数的单位,无论是通过答题,类别不可知数计数,语言引导密度估计,还是多模式数评价 Acharya等 (2019); Ranjan等 (2021); Jiang等 (2023); Paiss等 (2023). 这些提法评价一个模型是否能够找到和列举所请求的目标,同时让计数单位隐含. 镜面,透明的表面,和重复的成像路径将可见外观与物理实体相分离. 一个实体可以产生若干个空间上截然不同的观测结果,因此,同一目视盘点可以支持不同的计数,这取决于这些观测结果的分组方式。 因此,回答“多少”问题既要求恢复外观,又要求确定其中哪些人拥有物理来源。

blocks.en: We introduce PhysCount, a benchmark for testing whether MLLMs can distinguish visible appearances from the physical entities they depict. Built from 546 natural images, PhysCount comprises 651 target-specific groups and 4,595 questions. For each counting target, annotators mark all relevant appearances, record whether each is seen directly, in reflection, or through glass, and group appearances that depict the same entity. These annotations generate four types of questions about appearances, physical entities, image formation, and correspondence. Questions associated with the same image and target probe complementary quantities derived from one annotated scene. PhysCount evaluates each count separately and reports how often a model solves the complete question group.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PhysCount,这是测试MLLM能否区分可见外观和它们所描绘的物理实体的基准. PhysCount由546个自然图像所建,由651个目标群体和4 595个问题组成。 对于每个计数目标,注释器会标记所有相关外观,记录每个外观是直接被看到,反射,还是通过玻璃被看到,以及描绘同一实体的组外观. 这些说明产生了四种类型的问题,涉及外观,物理实体,图像形成,和通信. 从一个注解的场景中得出了与同一图像和目标探测器相匹配的数量有关的问题。 PhysCount分别评价每个计数,并报告一个模型如何经常解决完整的问题组.

blocks.en: Experiments with 40 MLLMs reveal a clear separation between appearance counting and questions that depend on physical identity. Errors increase when the correct count requires grouping repeated appearances or matching observations across different modes. Scaling and higher resolution improve individual answers more readily than they improve complete-group accuracy. Presenting related questions together substantially improves both aggregate accuracy and the number of groups solved in full. Across these results, the largest remaining difficulty lies in counts defined by appearance–entity correspondence rather than in appearance enumeration alone.
blocks.zh: 40 MLLMs的实验揭示出外观计数和取决于物理身份的问题之间的明显区别. 当正确的计数需要将重复的外观分组或在不同模式间匹配观测时,出错会增加. 放大和高分辨率比提高完整组的准确性更容易改进个人答案。 将相关问题一并提出,既能大大提高总的准确性,又能提高全部解决的组数。 在所有这些结果中,剩下的最大困难在于由表象-实体函证确定的计数,而不是仅以表象来计数。

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We identify an overlooked distinction in visual counting: visible appearances and physical entities are not always in one-to-one correspondence, so a correct numerical answer does not necessarily show that a model has counted the intended units. • We introduce PhysCount, comprising 546 natural images, 651 target-specific groups, and 4,595 questions. Its annotations record appearance locations, image-formation modes, and same-entity assignments, supporting questions about appearances, physical entities, image formation, and correspondence, together with strict complete-group evaluation. • We evaluate 40 representative MLLMs and show that appearance counts are more reliable than counts requiring physical-identity correspondence. Performance declines on repeated and cross-mode appearances, while joint question presentation improves complete-group accuracy.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们找出了在视觉计数中被忽视的区别:可见的外观和物理实体并不总是在一对一的对应中,所以正确的数字答案并不一定显示模型已经计算出预定的单位. —— 我们介绍PhysCount,包括546个自然图像、651个目标群体和4 595个问题。 它的注释记录了外观位置,图像成形模式,以及同实体的任务,支持关于外观,物理实体,图像形成,和通信的问题,同时进行严格的完整组评价. ^ 我们评价了40个具有代表性的MLLM,并表明外观计数比需要物理识别通信的计数更可靠. 重复出场和跨模式出场的性能下降,而联合提问演示则能提高完整组的准确性.

blocks.en: We identify an overlooked distinction in visual counting: visible appearances and physical entities are not always in one-to-one correspondence, so a correct numerical answer does not necessarily show that a model has counted the intended units.
blocks.zh: 我们识别出在视觉计数中被忽略的区别:可见外观和物理实体并不总是在一对一的对应中,因此正确的数字答案并不一定显示模型已经计算出预期的单位.

blocks.en: We introduce PhysCount, comprising 546 natural images, 651 target-specific groups, and 4,595 questions. Its annotations record appearance locations, image-formation modes, and same-entity assignments, supporting questions about appearances, physical entities, image formation, and correspondence, together with strict complete-group evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍PhysCount,包括546个自然图像、651个目标群体和4 595个问题。 其说明会记录外观位置,图像-成形模式,以及同实体的任务,支持关于外观,物理实体,图像形成,和通信的问题,同时进行严格的完整组评价.

blocks.en: We evaluate 40 representative MLLMs and show that appearance counts are more reliable than counts requiring physical-identity correspondence. Performance declines on repeated and cross-mode appearances, while joint question presentation improves complete-group accuracy.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了40个具有代表性的MLLM,并表明外观计数比需要物理识别通信的计数更可靠. 重复出场和跨模式出场的性能下降,而联合提问演示则能提高完整组的准确性.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Visual counting benchmarks have broadened both the form of supervision and the range of scenes under evaluation. TallyQA frames counting as question answering in natural images, while category-agnostic and language-guided methods study transfer to previously unseen targets Acharya et al. (2019) ; Ranjan et al. (2021) ; Jiang et al. (2023) ; Paiss et al. (2023) . Recent multimodal benchmarks further examine dense and open-world counting, numerical question answering, and the counting behavior of general-purpose vision–language models Mondal et al. (2025) ; Deitke et al. (2025) ; Tamarapalli et al. (2025) ; Weng et al. (2025) ; Deng et al. (2026) . Other work changes the information that must be selected or inferred: MIND and PairTally emphasize linguistic target specification Ciampi et al. (2025) ; Nguyen et al. (2025) , CAPTURe recovers counts under occlusion Pothiraj et al. (2025) , and video or audio-visual benchmarks extend enumeration across time and modalities Lu et al. (2026) ; Tsuchiya et al. (2026) ; Rong et al. (2026) . This progression has made counting more open-ended, compositional, and robust to incomplete evidence, but the unit being counted is still generally a visible category instance or an instance inferred to occupy the scene. Work on numerical cognition offers a complementary view: small-set judgments and approximate numerosity are distinct processes, while object-based accounts tie number to representations that persist across changes in view Mandler and Shebo (1982) ; Feigenson et al. (2004) ; Wynn (1992) ; Kahneman et al. (1992) . PhysCount extends this distinction to MLLMs by evaluating two abilities separately: enumerating visible appearances and grouping appearances that depict the same physical entity.
blocks.zh: 视觉计数基准扩大了监督的形式和评价中的场景范围。 塔利语 QA帧计为在自然图像中回答问题,而分类不可知和语言指导方法研究向先前未见的目标Acharya等(2019);Ranjan等(2021);Jiang等(2023);Paiss等(2023)。 最近的多模式基准进一步审查了密集和开放的世界计数、数字问题回答和通用视觉-语言模型Mondal等人(2025);Deitke等人(2025);Tamarapalli等人(2025);Weng等人(2025);Deng等人(2026)。 其他工作改变了必须选择或推断的信息:MIND和PairTally强调语言目标规格Ciampi等人(2025年);Nguyen等人(2025年);CAPTURe恢复了被封存的Pothiraj等人(2025年)的计数;视频或视听基准在时间和方式上扩展了Lu等人(2026年);Tsuchiya等人(2026年);Rong等人(2026年)。 这一进展使计算更具开放性、组成性、强力和不完整的证据,但计算中的单位一般仍是一个可见的类别实例或推断占用现场的实例。 关于数字认知的工作提供了一种补充性的观点:小数据集的判断和大致数字是不同的过程,而基于对象的账户则与Mandler和Shebo(1982年)、Feigenson等人(2004年)、Wynn(1992年)、Kahneman等人(1992年)的观点中持续存在的各种变化相关联。 PhysCount通过分别评价两种能力,将这种区分扩展到了MLLMs: 列举能描绘同一种物理实体的可见外观和分组外观.

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks examine mirror understanding in MLLMs from two distinct perspectives. MirrorQA evaluates subject-centered left–right reasoning in mirror images, testing whether models correctly transform spatial orientation Liu et al. (2026) . MirrorBench adopts an embodied perspective: inspired by the mirror self-recognition paradigm, it evaluates self-centric intelligence from basic mirror perception to higher-level self-representation in simulated environments Guo et al. (2026) . PhysCount targets a different capability. Rather than asking models to infer orientation or recognize themselves, it asks them to enumerate the target appearances in a scene and determine which of those appearances depict the same physical entity. This requires handling mirror-only entities, direct views paired with reflections, and multiple reflections generated by one entity. PhysCount represents these cases explicitly by annotating each appearance, its image-formation mode, and its physical-identity group, then evaluates the resulting appearance, entity, and correspondence counts.
blocks.zh: 最近的基准从两个不同的角度审查对小额供资和微型企业中的镜像理解。 镜像 QA评价以主题为主的左-右对镜图像推理,测试模型是否正确转变了空间取向 刘等 (2026). Mirror Bench采用了一个被包含的视角:受镜像自我识别范式的启发,它评价自心智能从基本的镜像感知到模拟环境中更高层次的自代表. 郭等 (2026) (中文(简体) ). PhysCount针对不同的能力. 它不要求模型推断取向或识别自己,而是要求它们列举某一场景中的目标外观,并确定其中哪个外观描绘出同一个实体. 这需要处理仅镜像的实体,直接视图与反射对等,以及由一个实体产生的多重反射. PhysCount通过对每个外观,其图像-成形模式,以及其物理识别组进行注释来明确代表这些案例,然后对由此产生的外观,实体,和函证数进行评价.

blocks.en: 3 PhysCount: Counting Beyond Visible Appearances
blocks.zh: 3 PhysCount: 计数超越可见外观

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 制定任务

blocks.en: PhysCount presents a model with an image and a target-specific counting question and expects an integer answer. The number of visible target appearances may differ from the number of objects in the scene. The same object may be seen directly and in one or more mirrors, while another may be visible only through reflection or glass. The question determines whether the model should count each visible appearance or merge appearances that depict the same physical entity.
blocks.zh: PhysCount 呈现出一个带有图像和特定目标计数问题的模型并期望得到整数答案. 可见目标外观的数量可能与场景中物体的数量不同. 同一物体可以直接和在一个或多个镜子中看到,而另一个物体只能通过反射或玻璃来可见. 这个问题决定了模型是应该计算每个能显示的外观还是合并那些描绘同一个物理实体的外观.

blocks.en: PhysCount evaluates four question families: counting all visible appearances, counting physical entities, counting a specified type of appearance, and reasoning about appearance–entity correspondences. The same image can consequently admit several correct counts depending on what the question specifies. Together, these questions separate the recovery of visual evidence from the interpretation of that evidence in terms of physical entities.
blocks.zh: PhysCount评价了四个问题家族:计出所有可见的外观,计出物理实体,计出特定类型的外观,以及外观-实体对应的推理. 因此,同一图象可以承认若干正确数字,取决于问题的具体内容。 这些问题合在一起,将取回视觉证据与从物理实体角度解释这些证据分开。

blocks.en: 3.2 Data Collection and Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据收集和说明

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes the construction of PhysCount in three stages. First, we build the image set through automatic candidate filtering followed by human selection. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Qwen Team (2026b) filters natural images from Common Canvas Gokaslan et al. (2024) , GPIC Chandrasegaran et al. (2026) , and other public collections for mirror and glass scenes in which reflections or glass change the apparent count. Human annotators then inspect these candidates and select images with localizable targets, distinguishable direct, reflected, or through-glass appearances, and counts that can be resolved through careful inspection. The selected images contain salient appearance duplication or interactions between reflected and transmitted content.
blocks.zh: 图2总结了PhysCount分三个阶段建设的情况. 首先,我们通过自动筛选候选人,然后进行人类选择,来构建图像。 Quen3.6-35B-A3B (中文(简体) ). Quen Team (2026b)从Common Canvas Gokaslan等(2024),GPIC Chandrasegaran等(2026)过滤出自然图像,以及其他用于镜像和玻璃场景的公众收藏,其中反射或玻璃会改变表面的计数. 人类注释者然后检查这些候选人,并选择具有可定位目标,可分辨的直接,反射,或通过玻璃外观的图像,以及可以通过仔细检查解决的计数. 所选的图像包含显著的外观重复或反射和传输内容之间的相互作用.

blocks.en: Figure 2: PhysCount construction pipeline. Candidate mirror and glass scenes undergo automatic filtering and human selection. An annotator labels direct, reflected, and through-glass appearances, groups appearances of the same entity, and writes questions whose answers are derived from these groups. Here, five cat appearances form four entities, and the correspondence question selects the one entity seen both directly and in reflection. Annotation review and automated QA checking send consistent QAs to PhysCount and flagged QAs to final human correction.
blocks.zh: 图2 建筑工程管道。 候选镜和玻璃场景经过自动过滤和人的选择. 一个注释者直接地,反射地,并透过玻璃外观来标出同一实体的组外观,并写出从这些组中得出答案的问题. 在这里,5个猫的外观组成了4个实体,而函证问题则选择了直接和倒影中看到的一个实体. 注释审查和自动QA检查将一致的QAs发送到PhysCount,并标出QAs来最终进行人性矫正.

blocks.en: Second, annotators construct a target-specific scene representation. An image containing several suitable target categories produces a separate annotation group for each category. Within a group, annotators mark every visible target occurrence and label it as direct, reflected, or seen through glass. Occurrences depicting the same real-world object receive a common identity. Thus, each point records the location and type of one appearance, while each identity group records the physical entity depicted by one or more appearances. The grouping covers direct–reflection pairs, objects visible only in mirrors, and multiple reflections of one object.
blocks.zh: 其次,注释者构建了针对特定目标的场景表现. 包含几个合适目标类别的图像为每个类别产生单独的注释组. 在一组内,注释者标记出每个可见的目标发生并标出它为直接的,反射的,或者通过玻璃来看到. 描绘出同一种现实世界物体的事件获得共同的认同. 因此,每个点记录一个外观的位置和类型,而每个身份组记录一个或多个外观所描绘的物理实体. 编组覆盖了直接-反射对子,只可见于镜中的对象,以及一个物体的多反射.

blocks.en: Finally, the first annotator writes counting questions and their integer answers based on the completed scene annotation. A second annotator checks the appearance locations, appearance-type labels, and identity groups against the image. GPT-5.6 Sol then uses the verified annotation to check whether each human-written question can be answered from the recorded information and whether its answer gives the required count. A third annotator reviews and corrects every flagged QA pair. Appendix A provides the complete instructions and examples.

blocks.en: 3.3 Question Design
blocks.zh: 3.3 问题设计

blocks.en: PhysCount uses four question families to expose different failure points between seeing a target and recovering the physical scene. The image and target remain fixed while the required count changes, so success depends on selecting the correct counting unit and applying the required operation to the same annotated evidence. Figure 1 shows how the same scene yields different answers as the requested counting unit changes.
blocks.zh: PhysCount使用四个问题家庭来揭露从看到目标到恢复物理场景的不同故障点. 图像和目标在需要的计数变化时保持不变,所以成功与否取决于选择正确的计数单位,并将需要的操作应用到相同的附加说明的证据上. 图1显示同一场景如何随着所请求的计数单位的变化而产生不同的答案.

blocks.en: Appearance questions ask for every visible occurrence of the target, including direct, reflected, and through-glass appearances. The difficulty is to identify separate occurrences before deciding whether they share an identity. Reflections may be cropped, distorted, or repeated across mirrors, while reflected and transmitted content may overlap on the same glass surface. A model that merges similar-looking regions too early will miss valid appearances; one that splits a single occurrence into fragments will overcount them. Each annotation group includes one appearance question to measure this initial visual inventory.
blocks.zh: 外观问题询问目标每一次可见的出场,包括直接出场,反射出出场,并透镜出场. 困难在于在决定它们是否具有共同身份之前要识别不同的事件. 反射可能会被裁剪、扭曲或跨镜重复,而反射和传输的内容可能在同一玻璃表面重叠。 一个将相类似区域过早地合并的模式会错过有效的外观;一个将单个发生地分割为碎片的模式会超额计算. 每个注释组都包含一个外观问题来测量这个初始的视觉清点.

blocks.en: Entity questions ask how many physical objects are represented by that inventory. This requires matching appearances despite changes in position, scale, orientation, visibility, and appearance type. A direct observation and several mirror images may all depict one object, whereas two similar reflections may belong to different objects. Mirror-only entities add a further challenge because identity must be established without a direct appearance as an anchor. The resulting errors have two opposite forms: counting one object several times or merging distinct objects into one.
blocks.zh: 实体问题询问该清单中有多少实物。 尽管位置、规模、取向、能见度和外观类型都有所变化,但这需要匹配外观。 直接观测和多张镜像都可能描绘出一个物体,而两个相类似的反射可能属于不同的物体. 仅镜的实体又增加了一个挑战,因为身份必须建立,而不能直接以主播身份出现. 由此而来的错误有两种相反的形式:数出一个对象多次或者将不同的对象合并成一个.

blocks.en: Image-formation questions ask whether each appearance is seen directly, formed by reflection, or observed through glass. Object recognition alone does not determine this label: the same person or object can be visible directly, in reflection, and through glass in one image. Glass is especially demanding because reflected foreground content and transmitted background content occupy the same pixels, and their boundaries may cross or partly hide one another. The model must separate these layers and determine how each target occurrence becomes visible.
blocks.zh: 图像-造型问题询问每个外观是直接被看到,由反射形成,还是通过玻璃被观察到. 单是物体识别不能决定这个标签:同一人或物体可以直接可见,反射,也可以通过玻璃在一个图像中. 格拉斯要求特别高,因为反射的前景内容和传输的背景内容占据了相同的像素,其边界可能相互交叉或部分隐藏. 模型必须将这些层分出,并确定每个目标发生如何被可见.

blocks.en: Correspondence questions examine whether the recovered appearances, appearance types, and identities agree. They count intersections, exclusive sets, and multiplicities, such as entities seen both directly and in reflection or entities producing several mirror images. These answers depend on the full pattern of identity assignments: changing one appearance–entity match can alter several relation counts at once. The challenge is therefore not a single local match, but maintaining one consistent set of identities across all observed appearances.
blocks.zh: 函证问题审查恢复的外观、外观类型和身份是否一致。 它们计算了相交点,独有的集,和多相性,例如直接和反射中看到的实体或产生多相镜图像的实体. 这些答案取决于身份分配的全部模式:改变一个外观-实体匹配可以同时改变几个关系计数. 因此,挑战不是单一的本地匹配,而是在所有观察到的外观上保持一套一致的身份。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Evaluation Setting
blocks.zh: 4.1 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate 40 proprietary and open-weight MLLMs under a common task protocol. Unless stated otherwise, each question is answered independently from the same image, preventing related questions in an annotation group from sharing previous answers. Each model uses the strongest reasoning or thinking setting available in its evaluated backend and returns a single integer. Five human participants independently complete all 4,595 questions using the same image–question inputs; their metrics are averaged to form the human baseline. We preserve the native image resolution up to a 4,096 4{,}096 -pixel long edge and proportionally downsample larger images. The resolution and joint-question studies retain the same model configuration and image processing. Appendix B provides the prompts, backend-specific inference settings, and output-validation rules.
blocks.zh: 根据共同任务协议,我们评估40种专有和开放重量的MLLM。 除非另有说明,否则每个问题都从同一个图像中独立解答,使一个注释组中的相关问题无法共享先前的答案. 每个模型使用其评价后端中可用的最强推理或思维设置,并返回一整数. 5名人类参与者独立地用相同的图像-问题输入来完成所有4,595个问题;他们的衡量尺度平均构成人类基线. 我们保存着本地图像分辨率, 最高可达4,096 4{,}096-像素长边并成比例地向下取出更大的图像。 分辨率和联合问题研究保留了相同的模型配置和图像处理. 附 录 B提供了提示,后端特定推论设置,以及输出验证规则.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that Gemini 3.7 Flash achieves the highest overall Score, while Muse-Glimmer-30B and Qwen3.8-27B are the strongest open models. No model leads every metric. Qwen3.5-397B-A17B has the lowest appearance error and performs strongly on image formation, whereas Gemma 4-31B is more competitive on correspondence. Neither advantage produces the best overall Score. In contrast, the five-participant human average reaches 97.10 Score and 95.98 Group-Acc, showing that careful human observers can resolve nearly all quantities in a group together. The results distinguish three related capabilities: detecting what is visible, recognizing how each appearance is formed, and recovering the physical entities behind those appearances. Strength in one does not ensure strength in the others.
blocks.zh: 表1显示双子座 3.7 Flash实现了最高的整体分数,而Muse-Glimer-30B和Qune3.8-27B则是最强的开放型号. 没有模型领导每个度量。 Quen3.5-397B-A17B的外观出错最少,在图像形成上表现得很强,而Gemma 4-31B在函授上则更具竞争力. 两项优势都没有产生最佳的总体得分。 相比之下,由五人参与的人类平均得分达到97.10分和95.98个组-ACC,这表明谨慎的人类观察者可以共同解决一个组的几乎所有数量. 结果区分出三个相关能力:探测可见的事物,识别每个外观是如何形成的,并恢复这些外观背后的物理实体. 一个力量并不能确保另一个力量。

blocks.en: Across models, enumerating visible appearances is consistently easier than answering entity and correspondence questions. These questions use the same scene and counting target, but the latter require deciding which direct, reflected, and through-glass appearances depict the same object. Phys-Gnd remains well below its ceiling even on groups with an exact appearance answer. A correct appearance total therefore does not reliably carry over to counts defined by physical identity. The benchmark identifies this separation at the level of answer behavior; integer outputs alone do not determine which internal computation produced an error.
blocks.zh: 在整个模型中,列举可见的外表总是比回答实体和通信问题容易。 这些问题使用相同的场景和计数目标,但后者要求决定哪个直接,反射,和通过玻璃外观描绘出同一个物体. Phys-Gnd仍然远远低于其上限,甚至对于有准确外观答案的组而言也是如此. 因此,正确的外观总数不能可靠地结转到由实际身份定义的计数。 基准在回答行为层面识别出这种分离;单是整数输出并不能确定哪个内部计算产生错误.

blocks.en: Group-Acc sets a stricter requirement: every appearance, entity, image-formation, and correspondence question in a group must be answered exactly. Many models answer a substantial fraction of individual questions correctly, yet only Gemini solves more than 10% of annotation groups in full. Stronger model variants generally reduce error within each question family, but their Group-Acc remains low. Increased model capacity therefore improves individual counts more readily than it produces a complete solution to all quantities derived from the same annotated scene.
blocks.zh: Group-Acc设定了一个更严格的要求:一个组中的每一个外观,实体,图像的造型,以及通信问题都必须得到准确的回答. 许多模型正确回答了相当一部分单个问题,然而只有双子座完全解决了超过10%的注释组. 更强大的模型变体一般会减少每个问题家族内部的错误,但其Group-Acc仍然很低. 因此,模型能力的提高比对同一附加说明场景产生的所有数量提出一个完整的解决方案更方便地改善了个人计数。

blocks.en: 4.3 Detailed Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 详细分析

blocks.en: Table 2 traces how additional visual detail affects the counting process. Increasing the long-edge resolution improves the overall Score from 21.04 to 28.84, but most gains occur before the highest resolution. Appearance and correspondence errors reach their lowest values at 2,048 pixels and change little thereafter, while Group-Acc stops improving after 1,024 pixels. The different saturation points separate visual access from complete task success. Higher resolution helps models recover visible appearances, whereas solving an entire group also requires exact answers to its entity, image-formation, and correspondence questions. Once the visible inventory stabilizes, further pixels contribute little to these identity-dependent counts.
blocks.zh: 表2追踪额外视觉细节如何影响计数过程. 将远缘分辨率提高,总体得分从21.04分提高到28.84分,但大部分收益是在最高分辨率之前取得的. 外观和函证误差以2,048像素达到最低值,之后几乎没有变化,而Group-Acc在1,024像素后停止了改进. 不同的饱和点将视觉访问和完全的任务成功分开. 更高的分辨率帮助模型恢复可见的外观,而解决整个组还需要准确回答其实体,图像-造型,以及通信问题. 一旦可见的存货稳定下来,进一步的像素对这些依赖身份的计数贡献不大.

blocks.en: Table 3 compares independent and joint presentation. Joint presentation raises Score by more than eleven points and more than triples Group-Acc, with gains concentrated in entity and correspondence questions despite slightly worse image-formation performance. Questions in the same annotation group refer to the same appearances and physical entities but request different counts. Seeing these questions together gives the model access to the full set of counting operations associated with the scene. The large reductions in entity and correspondence error show that this presentation is especially helpful for identity-dependent counts, while the rise in Group-Acc means that substantially more annotation groups are solved in full.
blocks.zh: 表3比较了独立和联合列报。 提出联合陈述 得分超过11分,超过3分的Group-Acc,收益集中在实体和函文问题上,尽管图像形成表现略差. 同一注解组中的问题是指相同的外观和物理实体,但要求不同的计数. 将这些问题放在一起看,可以让模型访问与场景相关的全套计票操作. 实体和函证错误的大量减少表明,这种表述对依赖身份的计数特别有帮助,而Group-Acc的上升意味着大量更多的注释组被完全解决.

blocks.en: Figure 4 reveals clear differences in how stable model performance remains across counting targets. Gemini 3.7 Flash follows a relatively even profile, avoiding pronounced drops in several categories without leading every domain. Qwen3.8-27B and Gemma 4-31B reach higher peaks on selected targets but vary more across categories, and their local strengths do not transfer consistently to other targets. Several curves nevertheless rise and fall together across domains, showing that the target category systematically changes the difficulty of separating appearances and matching them to entities. The model-specific peaks further indicate that models rely on different category knowledge and identity cues.
blocks.zh: 图4显示,在计算目标之间,模型性能是否保持稳定存在明显差异。 双子座 3.7 Flash遵循相对均匀的剖面,避免了在多个类别中被宣告的下降而未领先每个域. Qwen3.8-27B和Gemma 4-31B在所选目标上达到更高的峰值,但因类别不同而差异较大,它们的地处优势不能一致地转移到其他目标. 然而,若干个曲线在多个领域一起起伏,表明目标类别系统地改变了区分外观和将其与实体相匹配的困难。 模型特有的峰值进一步表明模型依赖于不同的类别知识和身份提示.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Performance by appearance multiplicity. Entity NAE (a) and Score (b) grouped by the maximum number of appearances assigned to one entity; dashed lines show the equal-weight mean across all 40 models.
blocks.zh: 图5:按外观多样性分列的性能。 实体NAE(a)和分数(b)按分配给一个实体的最大外观数量分组;虚线显示所有40个模型的等重平均值。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Within- v.s. cross-mode correspondence. Correspondence NAE (a) and Score (b) after matching the appearance-multiplicity distributions of the two group types; annotations report the cross-mode minus within-mode difference.
blocks.zh: 图6:在V.s.中跨模式通信。 函式NAE(a)和分数(b)在匹配两类组的外观-多相分布之后;注解报告跨模减模内相差.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows that appearance multiplicity affects entity counting and joint performance at different stages. The 40-model mean entity NAE changes little from one to three appearances, then rises sharply in the four-or-more bin. Mean Score declines as multiplicity increases from one to two, partially recovers at three while remaining below the single-appearance level, and reaches its minimum at four or more. Gemini 3.7 Flash declines steadily across the four bins, whereas the other representative models fluctuate at intermediate multiplicities; nevertheless, 32 of the 40 models score lower in the highest-multiplicity bin than in the single-appearance bin. A small number of repeated appearances can therefore leave the entity count largely intact while already reducing the likelihood that appearance, entity, image-formation, and correspondence questions are all answered reliably. Each additional appearance supplies more visual evidence but also adds another correspondence that the requested entity count must resolve. These effects can offset each other at lower multiplicities; with four or more appearances, both entity counting and joint performance deteriorate.
blocks.zh: 图5显示,外观繁多影响实体在不同阶段的计算和联合业绩。 40型的指名实体NAE从一到三相外观变化不大,再在四相或多相的相框中急剧上升. 平均得分下降,因为多重性从1个增加到2个,部分恢复到3个,同时低于单一出现水平,最低达到4个或更多。 双子座 3.7 Flash 在整个4个垃圾箱中稳步下降,而其他代表性模型则以中间多相起伏;然而,40个模型中,32个在多相起伏最高的垃圾箱中得分低于单相起伏的垃圾箱中得分. 因此,少数重复的外观可以使实体基本完好无损,同时已经减少了外观、实体、图像形成和函证问题都得到可靠回答的可能性。 每次增加的外观都提供了更多的视觉证据,但也增加了被请求实体必须解决的另一封信函。 这些效应可以在更低的倍数中相互抵消;有四个或更多的外观,实体计数和联合性能都恶化了.

blocks.en: After matching the appearance-multiplicity distributions, Figure 6 shows higher cross-mode correspondence error for all four representative models, with the same pattern appearing in 31 of the 40 evaluated models. Counts based on identity correspondence are thus sensitive not only to the number of observations, but also to how those observations are formed. Models can answer simpler appearance questions correctly while still missing counts that require direct, reflected, and transmitted observations to be treated as views of the same entity. Aggregate Score does not decline in parallel because direct views can simplify individual counts and offset errors in cross-mode correspondence. A competitive Score can therefore coexist with substantial errors on questions that require cross-mode identity matching.
blocks.zh: 在匹配外观-多相分布后,图6显示所有四个代表性模型的跨模式函证误差较高,40个被评价模型中的31个也出现了相同的模式. 因此,基于身份函证的计数不仅对观测次数十分敏感,而且对这些观测如何形成也十分敏感. 模型可以正确回答更简单的外观问题,同时仍然缺失的计数,这些计数需要直接,反射,传输的观测结果作为同一实体的观点处理. 累积分数不平行下降,因为直接取景可以简化个人计数并抵消跨模式函证中的错误. 因此,在需要跨模式身份匹配的问题上,竞争性的分数可以与重大错误并存。

blocks.en: Across the four analyses, models improve at enumerating appearances before they reliably answer counts defined by physical identity. Higher resolution improves access to visible evidence, while repeated and cross-mode observations remain difficult; the joint-prompting experiment also improves complete-group correctness. The central challenge is therefore to organize observations around persistent physical entities rather than count them in isolation. Future evaluation can complement final counts with explicit appearance and identity predictions, separating missed evidence from incorrect grouping. For physical AI, this points toward scene understanding whose entity-level predictions remain stable across image formation, viewpoint, and time NVIDIA et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 在所有四项分析中,模型在可靠地回答由物理身份定义的计数之前,在列举外表方面有所改进。 更高的分辨度能改善对可见证据的取用,而反复和跨模式的观测仍然很困难;联合快取实验也能提高完整组的正确性. 因此,主要的挑战是围绕持续存在的物理实体组织观察,而不是孤立地计算这些实体。 未来的评价可以通过明确的外观和身份预测来补充最终计数,将错失的证据与错误的分组区分开来. 就物理AI而言,这指向了解在图像形成、视野和时间方面NVIDIA等人(2026年),其实体一级的预测保持稳定。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced PhysCount, a benchmark for evaluating whether MLLMs distinguish visual appearances from the physical entities that produce them. By deriving 4,595 related questions from shared appearance–entity annotations, PhysCount evaluates individual counts and complete-group correctness across appearance, entity, image-formation, and correspondence questions. Experiments with 40 MLLMs show that appearance counts are more reliable than counts requiring physical-identity correspondence, particularly when entities appear repeatedly or across observation modes. Higher resolution reduces appearance error without eliminating the remaining identity-dependent errors, while joint presentation substantially increases the number of groups solved in full. These results separate two observable capabilities: enumerating visible evidence and answering counts defined by how that evidence maps to physical objects. Progress toward physical scene understanding should make entity-centered predictions stable across reflection, transmission, viewpoint, and time. Such stability would support reasoning about enduring objects and their interactions rather than treating each visual occurrence as an independent counting unit. PhysCount exposes the gap between counting what is visible and correctly counting the physical entities those observations depict.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了PhysCount,作为评估MLLMs是否区分视觉外观与产生视觉外观的物理实体的基准. PhysCount从共同的外观-实体说明中得出了4,595个相关问题,评价了个人的计数和整个组的正确性,包括外观、实体、图像形成和函证问题。 40 MLLMs的实验表明外观计数比需要物理识别通信的计数更可靠,特别是在实体反复出现或跨观察模式出现时. 更高的分辨率可以减少外观出错而不会去除剩余的依赖身份的错误,而联合演示则会大大增加被完全解决的组数. 这些结果将两种可观测能力分开:列举可见证据并回答如何将证据映射到物理物体上所定义的计数。 在了解物理场景方面取得进展,应能使以实体为中心的预测在反射、传播、观点和时间之间保持稳定。 这种稳定性将支持关于持久物体及其相互作用的推理,而不是将每个视觉发生作为一个独立的计算单位。 PhysCount揭示了这些观测所描绘的对可见物的计算与对物理实体的正确计算之间的差距.

blocks.en: Appendix A Scene Curation and Annotation Verification
blocks.zh: 附录A 场景校正和注释核实

blocks.en: Section 3.2 describes the construction of PhysCount. This section focuses on two boundaries that require further detail: when a mirror or glass scene genuinely changes the count, and how physical identity is established when no direct appearance is visible. We then describe the QA audit and provide complete annotation examples.
blocks.zh: 第3.2节描述了PhysCount的建设. 本节主要讲述需要更详细描述的两个界限:一是一面镜子或玻璃场景真正改变计数时,一是没有直接外观可见时,如何确定物理身份. 然后,我们描述质量保证审计,并提供完整的说明实例。

blocks.en: A.1 Candidate Scene Boundaries
blocks.zh: A.1 候选场景边界

blocks.en: Candidate images are drawn from Common Canvas Gokaslan et al. (2024) , GPIC Chandrasegaran et al. (2026) , and other public collections. We retain two scene types: reflection produces a clear duplicate of a countable target, or targets behind glass overlap with salient surface reflections in a way that changes target boundaries or apparent multiplicity. A reflective surface alone is insufficient, and the target must remain reliably countable after careful inspection.
blocks.zh: 候选相片取自Common Canvas Gokaslan等 (2024年),GPIC Chandrasegaran等 (2026年)等公共相片. 我们保留了两种场景类型:反射产生一个可以计数的目标的明显重复,或者玻璃后的目标与显著的地表反射重叠,以改变目标界限或明显的多重性. 光是反光地表是不够的,经过仔细检查,目标必须能够可靠地计算。

blocks.en: The curation criteria separate physical existence from the path of observation. Objects seen directly or through a transparent medium are treated as real objects; only appearances formed on a reflective surface are reflections. Content displayed on televisions, posters, photographs, or paintings is excluded, as are shadows, highlights, and weak reflections on wet surfaces. One entity together with a complete mirror appearance is sufficient to create meaningful appearance duplication. Ordinary transmission is not: an object merely seen through glass does not enter the benchmark unless a surface reflection also introduces duplication, overlap, or an identity relation.
blocks.zh: 校正标准将物理存在与观测路径相分离. 直接或通过透明介质看到的物体,被作为真实物体处理;只有反射表面形成的外观才是反射. 在电视、海报、照片或绘画上展示的内容,以及阴影、亮点和湿地表面的微弱反射,都排除在外。 一个实体加上完整的镜子外观就足以产生有意义的外观重复. 普通传输不是:仅仅从玻璃上看到的物体不会进入基准,除非表面反射还引入了重复,重叠或身份关系.

blocks.en: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Qwen Team (2026b) evaluates each candidate twice. The first pass identifies the counting target and checks countability, reflection salience, and counting ambiguity. Only candidates satisfying every condition proceed to a second judgment. The second pass receives the image and target category without the first-pass rationale, and independently verifies the duplicated or mixed reflection–transmission structure. Both records are validated as structured JSON, and a fixed conjunction of their fields determines retention.
blocks.zh: Quen3.6-35B-A3B (中文(简体) ). Quen Team (2026b)对每个候选人进行两次评价. 首通分辨计数目标并检查可计数性,反射突出,计数模糊. 只有符合每个条件的候选人才能作出第二次判决。 第二通取取影像和目标类而无先行通理,并独立地验证被重复或混合反射-传递结构. 这两种记录都被验证为结构化的JSON,并且其域的固定结合决定了保留.

blocks.en: A.1.1 First-Pass Screening
blocks.zh: A.1.1 第一次审查

blocks.en: The first pass rejects weak or incomplete reflections, reflective content unrelated to the target, and scenes that do not support reliable human counting. Source captions serve only as retrieval cues; visible evidence determines the decision.
blocks.zh: 第一张通路拒绝微弱或不完整的反射,与目标无关的反射内容,以及不支持可靠人数的场景. 源标题仅作为检索提示;可见证据决定了决定.

blocks.en: PROMPT Stage-one screening
blocks.zh: 组合 第一阶段筛选

blocks.en: The response records the proposed target and scene type together with judgments of countability, reflection salience, and counting ambiguity. Every condition must be satisfied before verification.
blocks.zh: 反应记录了拟议的目标和场景类型,以及可计数性、反射性突出性和计算模糊性的判断。 核查之前必须满足每个条件。

blocks.en: A.1.2 Independent Verification
blocks.zh: A.1.2 独立核查

blocks.en: The verification pass reassesses whether the scene is photographic, the target is countable, and reflection creates either genuine duplication or a consequential interaction with transmission. Rejected candidates are assigned to fixed categories covering non-photographic content, mediated images, abstract reflections, irrelevant glass, unclear or uncountable targets, and structurally simple scenes.
blocks.zh: 核查证重新评估场景是否为相片取景,目标是否可计数,反射要么产生真正的重复,要么与传输产生相应的相互作用. 被否决的候选人被分配到固定的类别,包括非相片内容,介质图像,抽象反射,不相干玻璃,不明确或无法统计的目标,以及结构简单的场景.

blocks.en: PROMPT Independent verification
blocks.zh: 组合 独立核查

blocks.en: A.1.3 Final Selection
blocks.zh: A.1.3 最后选择

blocks.en: The final decision uses no additional model score. A retained image must satisfy every first-pass condition and receive an affirmative verification decision with high countability, counting value, and reflection salience, confirmed counting ambiguity, and no false-positive type.
blocks.zh: 最后决定没有使用额外的模型分数. 保留图像必须满足每个先行条件,并获得一个具有高可数性、计数值和反射显著性、确认计数模糊性、没有虚假阳性类型的肯定核查决定。

blocks.en: Ordinary transmission does not pass this rule even when the transmitted targets are clear. Through-glass appearances remain eligible inside a mixed reflection–transmission scene. This distinction ensures that every retained image contains an image-formation effect that changes the correspondence between visible appearances and physical entities.
blocks.zh: 普通传输即使传输目标清晰,也不会通过这个规则. 透过镜片的外观在混合反射-传送场景中仍符合资格. 这种区分确保了每个被保留的图像都包含一个图像-成形效应,可以改变可见外观和物理实体之间的对应.

blocks.en: A.2 Annotation Verification
blocks.zh: A.2 注释核查

blocks.en: A physical entity need not have a direct appearance in the image. Several mirror-only appearances may belong to one entity, while direct, reflected, and through-glass appearances may all refer to the same object. Multi-mirror identities are recorded as complete same-instance groups rather than disconnected pairwise links. When an image contains several suitable target categories, each category forms a separate annotation group.
blocks.zh: 物理实体不需要在图像中直接出现. 几个只镜的外观可能属于一个实体,而直接的,反射的,和通过镜的外观都可能都指同一种物体. 多镜像身份被记录为完整的同声团,而不是断开的双相连接. 当一个图像包含几个合适的目标类别时,每个类别组成一个单独的注释组.

blocks.en: The first annotator marks appearance locations and modes, groups appearances by physical identity, and writes the questions and answers from the image. A second annotator checks the appearance locations, image-formation labels, and identity groups against the source image. GPT-5.6 Sol then recomputes each answer from the verified annotation and checks whether the question meaning agrees with that calculation. A third annotator resolves every flagged case.
blocks.zh: 第一个注释者标记了外观位置和模式,分组以物理身份出现,并写出从图像中产生的问答. 第二名注释员对照源图像检查外观位置,图像-形状标签和身份组. GPT-5.6 常规 索尔再从已核实的注释中重算出每个答案,并检查问题含义是否与该计算一致. 第三个注释员解决了每个标注的案件

blocks.en: Appearance questions count annotated observations; entity questions count physical objects or identity groups; image-formation questions select observations by mode; and correspondence questions compute intersections, exclusions, and multiplicities over identity groups. This shared annotation makes every answer auditable from the same scene record.
blocks.zh: 外观问题计有附加说明的观察;实体问题计有物理物体或身份组;图像-造型问题按模式选择观察;和函证问题计算相交,排除,和相乘于身份组. 这份共享注释使得每个答案都可以从同一个场景记录中审计.

blocks.en: A.2.1 Question–Answer Consistency Audit
blocks.zh: A.2.1 问题 - 答复一致性审计

blocks.en: For each question, the auditor identifies the requested counting unit, selects the relevant appearances or identity groups, and derives the expected answer through an explicit set operation. The audit covers total and mode-specific appearances, distinct entities, entities defined by their available appearance types, reflection multiplicity, and counterfactual changes to an image-formation path.
blocks.zh: 对于每个问题,审计员确定要求的计数单位,选择相关的外观或身份组,并通过明确的设定操作得出预期答案. 审计范围包括整体外观和模式特有外观,不同实体,由现有外观类型所定义的实体,反射多端,以及反事实变化成像路径.

blocks.en: The derived answer is compared directly with the recorded QA. Agreement is marked correct ; a supported question with a conflicting answer is marked contradicted . Ambiguous questions, image–annotation conflicts, and insufficient evidence are sent to manual review, while questions requiring an unannotated attribute are marked unsupported . A semantically correct but unnatural question may be rewritten without changing its answer and is marked revised .
blocks.zh: 所得出的答案直接被与所记录的QA相比较. 协议是明显的正确;一个得到支持但答案相冲突的问题明显矛盾。 问题含糊不清、形象冲突、证据不足, 一个精密正确但又不自然的问题可能会被改写而不改变答案,并被标记为修改.

blocks.en: PROMPT Question–answer consistency audit
blocks.zh: 组合 问答一致性审计

blocks.en: A.3 Worked Annotation and QA Examples
blocks.zh: A.3 工作说明和质量保证实例

blocks.en: Figures 7 – 12 show all questions from six reviewed annotation groups. Each figure pairs the source image with its appearance–entity overlay. Blue D nodes mark direct physical-space appearances, orange R nodes mark reflected appearances, and green T nodes mark appearances seen through transparent media. Shared entity identifiers and connecting lines show which appearances depict the same object. The compact diagram below each image summarizes these identities, and the table gives every QA and its verified answer. Category A counts all visual appearances, E counts objects occupying physical space or distinct physical entities, I counts appearances by image-formation mode, and C queries relations between appearances and identity groups.
blocks.zh: 图7-12显示了6个经审查的说明组的所有问题。 每个图将源图像与其外观-实体相配. 蓝色 D 节点标记直接物理-空间外观,橙色 R 节点标记反射出外观,绿色 T 节点标记外观通过透明的媒体看到. 共享实体标识符和连接行显示哪个外观描绘同一个对象. 每个图像下方的紧凑图概括了这些身份,表格给出了每一个QA及其经核实的答案. 类别 A计出所有视觉外观, E计出占据物理空间或不同物理实体的物体, I按图像-造型模式计算出外观, C查询外观与身份组之间的关系.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Example 1: reflection and transmission of the same target category. Three cat appearances form two physical identities: one identity is observed directly and by reflection, while the other is seen through glass. The table reports every question derived from these annotations.
blocks.zh: 图7:例1:同一目标类别的反思和传输。 三只猫的外观形成两个物理特征:一个特征直接被观测出并被反射出,而另一个特征通过玻璃被观测出. 该表报告了从这些说明中得出的每个问题。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Example 2: one person with two reflected appearances. The direct appearance and both mirror appearances share one identity. The questions contrast appearance enumeration with physical occupancy, identity, and reflection multiplicity.
blocks.zh: 图8:例2:一人有2个反射出相. 直接外相和两相镜相貌都有一个特征. 这些问题将外观统计与实际占用、身份和反射的多相对比。

blocks.en: Figure 9: Example 3: one person distributed across three mirror regions. Four appearances map to one physical identity, enabling questions about total appearances, reflected subsets, physical–reflection overlap, and maximum multiplicity.
blocks.zh: 图9:例3:一人分布在三个镜像区域. 4个外观映射到1个物理身份,使关于总外观的问题成为可能,反射出子集,物理-反射重叠,以及最大多相.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Example 4: high reflection multiplicity from a single object. One physical die produces six reflected appearances. The resulting questions separate the seven visible appearances from one physical identity and its reflection multiplicity.

blocks.en: Appendix D Error Paths in Model-Generated Reasoning

blocks.en: A wrong integer does not identify the operation that failed. We therefore examine three cases whose generated reasoning exhibits a different error path: constructing the appearance inventory, linking appearances into physical identities, and applying the requested set operation. For each case, we reproduce the complete reasoning of two representative models in its original order, followed by an analysis of the first consequential divergence. These cases illustrate observable reasoning paths rather than estimate their prevalence, and generated reasoning is not treated as a direct readout of a model’s internal computation.
blocks.zh: 错误的整数不能识别失败的操作 。 因此,我们审查了三个案例,这些案例的推理显示了不同的错误路径:构建外观清单,将外观与实际身份联系起来,以及应用所要求的成套操作。 对于每一种情况,我们都照原样照搬两个代表性模型的完整推理,然后分析第一个相应的差异。 这些案件说明了可观察到的推理途径,而不是估计其普遍性,生成的推理不被视为一个模型的内部计算的直接读出.

blocks.en: Gemma’s generated reasoning builds the answer from observations: it enumerates two direct plants, independently enumerates three reflections, and only then adds the two sets. MiniCPM’s rationale reverses that dependency. After finding two direct plants, it assumes that the mirror must contain one copy of each and fixes the reflected count at two. The third reflected plant disappears from the final tally because it violates this assumed one-to-one mapping.
blocks.zh: Gemma所生成的推理从观察中构建了答案:它列举了两个直接的植物,独立地列举了三个反射,只有之后才添加了这两组. MiniCPM的理由推翻了这种依赖。 在找到两个直立植物后,它假设镜面必须包含每个相片的一个拷贝并将所反射的计数修正为两个. 第三个反射的植物从最终计分中消失,因为它违反了这个假设的一对一绘图.

blocks.en: The recorded mistake comes from treating a reflection as a duplicate of the visible crop rather than as another view of the surrounding scene. A mirror may reveal a source outside the camera frustum, omit a visible source because of its orientation, or show one source in several panels. None of these cases preserves the direct count. In this example, the reflected regions must remain in the appearance inventory before their physical sources are considered; the MiniCPM rationale instead uses a one-to-one identity assumption to revise the tally.
blocks.zh: 所记录的错误来自于将反射作为可见收成的复制品,而不是作为周围场景的另一种取景. 镜像可能暴露出相机frustum外的出处,会因其取向而省略出可见出处,或者在多块面板上显示出一个出处. 这些案件都无法维持直接计算。 在这个例子中,所反映区域必须留在外观清单中,然后再考虑其物理来源;而MiniCPM的理由则使用一对一的身份假设来修改清点.

blocks.en: Gemma’s rationale stops after detecting three salient shoe regions. InternVL instead explains why the regions are repeated: the shoes lie against a mirror, and the rear-looking pair is generated by reflection. The observable difference is not simply more careful arithmetic. InternVL changes the unit being counted from image regions to connected identity groups.
blocks.zh: Gemma在发现三个突出的鞋区后, InternVL转而解释为什么这些区域会被重复:鞋子倒在一面镜子上,而后视双由反射产生. 所观察到的差别并不仅仅是比较谨慎的算术。 InternVL将从图像区域算起的单位改为连接的身份组.

blocks.en: This distinction is easy to lose because visual similarity alone does not determine identity. Matching color and design are compatible with both a reflected shoe and another shoe from the same product line. The relevant evidence is relational: the mirror boundary, reversed placement, and the alignment between direct and reflected regions. InternVL’s rationale uses these cues to introduce two cross-boundary identity links, whereas Gemma’s does not. Expressed in the benchmark’s annotation graph, their stated interpretations disagree on the edges and therefore on the number of connected components.
blocks.zh: 这种区分容易被丢失,因为光是视觉相似性并不能决定身份. 相匹配的颜色和设计都与同一种产品线上反射出的一种鞋和另一种鞋相兼容. 有关证据是关系性的:镜像边界,倒置位置,以及直接和反射区域之间的相接. InternVL的理由利用这些提示引入了两个跨边界的身份链接,而Gemma则没有。 在基准的注释图中表示,他们所说的解释在边缘以及因此在连接部件的数量上有分歧。

blocks.en: Qwen’s rationale describes the relevant visual structure: one foreground dancer, background reflections, and multiple mirror panels as the source of repetition. The answer changes after the question is paraphrased as the number of “real dancers on stage.” The stated computation then becomes | P | |P| although the question asks for | P ∖ R | |P\setminus R| , where P P contains identities with direct appearances and R R contains identities with reflected appearances.
blocks.zh: Quen的原理描述了相关的视觉结构:一个前地舞者,背景反射,以及多个镜面板作为重复的来源. 答案在问题之后被解释为“真正的舞者在舞台上”。 所描述的计算随后成为了QQ P + + + + + + ,尽管问题要求的是 QQ P R + + P setminus R + ,其中 P 包含有直接外观的身份,而 R R 包含有被反射外观的身份.

blocks.en: Gemma’s rationale retains the exclusion predicate. It first places the directly visible dancer in P P , then places the same identity in R R , and removes it. The answer is zero even though the physical set is nonempty. The two recorded rationales therefore differ at the requested operation: Qwen’s scene description is largely sufficient, but its final count is not licensed by that description.
blocks.zh: Gemma的理由保留了排除的前提。 它首先将直接可见的舞者放入PP中,再将相同的身份放入RR中并取出. 答案是0,尽管物理设定是非空的. 因此,所记录的两个理由在要求的行动中有所不同: Quen的场景描述基本足够了,但最终的计数并没有被该描述所许可.

blocks.en: The unsuccessful trace repeatedly strengthens the correct claim that there is one physical dancer, yet never restores the discarded phrase “with no reflection.” In this case, additional reasoning increases confidence without improving semantic fidelity. The missing operation, rather than the amount of visual inspection, determines the wrong answer.
blocks.zh: 不成功的踪迹一再强化了有一位肢体舞者这一正确说法,但从未恢复“没有反射”这一被抛弃的短语。 在这种情况下,额外的推理在不提高语义忠诚度的情况下会增强信心. 缺少操作,而不是视觉检查的数量,决定了错误的答案.

blocks.en: The cases establish a narrower but important point: the same final counting error can accompany different observable reasoning failures. In the plant rationale, a one-to-one reflection assumption changes the appearance tally; in the shoe rationale, the stated identity links are incomplete; in the dancer rationale, the exclusion operator is dropped after the scene has been described. Aggregate integer metrics identify which question families and scene structures are difficult, but they cannot distinguish these paths on their own.
blocks.zh: 案例确立了一个更窄但重要的点:同样的最终计数错误可以伴随不同的可观察到的推理失败. 在"植物原理"中,一对一的反射假设会改变外观计数;在"鞋原理"中,所陈述的身份联系不完整;在"舞者原理"中,在描述出场后,排除操作员被放弃. 综合整数测量法确定哪些质疑家庭和场景结构是困难的,但它们无法单独区分这些路径.

blocks.en:
The joint-presentation result in Section 4.3 is compatible with reuse of
appearance and identity information across related questions, but it does not
identify that reuse as the causal internal mechanism. Directly separating
appearance detection, identity linking, and set operations would require
structured predictions for the appearance nodes, formation labels, identity
edges, and requested operation. The present traces serve instead as qualitative
examples of why those intermediate outputs would make future diagnosis more
precise.
